activity_summary: At Holywell, Richard Burbage gave you the old lath stage-sword, the paint worn off the hilt, and said it killed four Richmonds, for you to tell the boy. You said you would tell him when you put it in his hand, and that is not this week.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Took the sword and kept the line for the boy.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Gave up the sword and the four Richmonds.

topics: the boy not yet given it

quotes.speaker: richard_burbage
quotes.text: It killed four Richmonds. Tell the boy.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I will tell him when I put it in his hand.
